newsitem.title: FRANCE: Generale Sucriere plans Bresles plant closure.
newsitem.headline: Generale Sucriere plans Bresles plant closure.

text.p: Generale Sucriere, a unit of Saint-Louis, said on Monday that it planned to close its Bresles sugar plant.
The news was given last Thursday to a works committee at Generale Sucriere but the plan must be negotiated with workers' representatives, it said in a statement.
The plant located in the Oise region in the northwest of Paris employs 120 people and produced 96,000 tonnes of white sugar in 1995/96.
Generale Sucriere produced 806,000 tonnes of sugar in 1995/96.
Generale Sucriere said it would offer "a solution" to all the employees of the Bresles plant but did not provide further details.
The group linked the closure to its efforts to rationalise production amid growing competition from other European sugar producers and a restructuring of the European sugar industry.
"Due to high fixed costs and an unfavourable location, the Bresles plan is in an unfavorable position when compared to other production sites of the Generale Sucriere group," the statement said.
